tracks.title: Journey To Sleep: High Speed Train

metadata.description:
All aboard the super-fast electric train for a smooth and cozy night ride! In this relaxing bedtime story, you’ll step into a comfy cabin, settle into a soft bed, and feel the gentle hum of the train as it speeds through the night.  

Help prepare for the journey: close the door, dim the lights, and snuggle under the warm covers as the train glides quietly along the tracks. With the stars twinkling outside and the soft hum of the engine, it's the perfect way to drift off to sleep.  

After the story, the sound of the train smoothly traveling through the night will continue playing for a whole hour, creating a calming atmosphere to keep you relaxed until you're fast asleep. 

Voiced by Harriet Blackamore, Sound Design by Emma Mills, Written & Produced by Neil Mossey.
